title: SnF2 crystal: polymorph, orientation and unmeasured geometries from polarized Raman

decision_points.fork: Match raw database (PBEsol) frequencies or fit a global frequency scale
decision_points.consequence: s off by -2.3 %; face-B phonon off by -2.3 %; raw nearest-line matching also prefers the line-dense alpha record

decision_points.fork: Pure multiplicative scale through the origin, or a scale plus an axis offset revealed by the Stokes/anti-Stokes asymmetry (and the asymmetric notch edges)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit s through the origin to the Stokes lines
decision_points.consequence: The +2.12 cm-1 calibration offset of the spectrometer axis is absorbed into s: +0.75 % (tolerance 0.2 %), face-B phonon +0.94 %
decision_points.difficulty_type: confounder discovered in the raw spectra

decision_points.fork: Compare candidates by peak positions alone or by a forward model of intensities and polarization selection rules
decision_points.wrong_choice: Nearest-line matching of observed peaks to each candidate (with or without a scale)
decision_points.consequence: The monoclinic alpha record (69 Raman lines) wins by line density (mean deviation 3.5 vs 6.1 cm-1); its forward-model chi2/point is 141 against 2.6
decision_points.difficulty_type: which analysis discriminates between competing explanations

decision_points.fork: Orthorhombic beta versus its tetragonal near-twin gamma, whose strong lines nearly coincide
decision_points.wrong_choice: Accept gamma (higher symmetry, same main lines) without resolving the split doublets, low-frequency modes and in-plane anisotropy
decision_points.consequence: Wrong polymorph; s -0.24 %, face-B phonon +1.9 %, ratio +13.7 % (gamma chi2/point 57 against 2.6)
decision_points.difficulty_type: near-degenerate competing explanation; resolution and polarization evidence

decision_points.fork: Which polarizer/analyzer settings to buy: parallel and crossed along the lab axes only, or rotated settings as well
decision_points.consequence: A mirror-related orientation fits identically (chi2 equal to 1e-9); the wrong branch puts the c axis 65 deg off, the ratio off by -35 % and the face-B phonon off by +4.9 %. The consequence is visible only after buying rotated settings

decision_points.fork: Model the face-A spectra with the archived TO modes, or LO-mix the polar modes for q along the face normal (Born charges, eps_inf)
decision_points.wrong_choice: TO modes only, both in the orientation fit and for the face-B phonon
decision_points.consequence: Oblique LO lines (e.g. near 404 and 472 cm-1 on the axis) are unexplained; the orientation fit is biased by 12 deg (ratio +24 %); the face-B phonon taken from the TO list is -8.4 % off
decision_points.difficulty_type: evidence in the data (lines absent from the TO list); cascade into the orientation

decision_points.fork: How to use the archived Born charges (3 rows for 12 atoms in beta: one per symmetry-independent atom)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assign each row unrotated to all atoms of its orbit, use isotropic charges, or omit eps_inf screening
decision_points.consequence: Face-B phonon +5.7 % (unrotated; acoustic sum rule violated), -7.9 % (isotropic), +56 % (no eps_inf)
decision_points.difficulty_type: released data whose shape and convention must be discovered

decision_points.fork: Weak extra lines: a minority phase, LO-mixed lines of the main phase, or noise
decision_points.wrong_choice: Ignore the weak lines or attribute them all to LO mixing
decision_points.consequence: The randomly oriented alpha inclusions (3 % by volume; strongest line near 364 cm-1 on the axis, depolarized identically in every setting) are missed
decision_points.difficulty_type: confounder that mimics the target effect

graded_fields: c_axis_lab within 6 deg (modulo sign and the face-normal 180-degree turn)

length_estimate.catalog: unbounded (any polarizer/analyzer angle, window and accumulation count)
length_estimate.why: Parsing three database records, writing a Raman forward model (tensor rotation, thermal factors, line shapes), a Stokes/anti-Stokes calibration, a symmetry expansion of the Born charges and an LO-mixing calculation, planning polarization settings and windows under a 20-unit budget, a global orientation search with multi-start fits per candidate, and a minority-phase test.

runtime_dependencies: numpy, scipy (runtime image); no extra packages

data_provenance.synthetic_measurements: forward model documented in SOURCE.md; hidden sample parameters in environment/lab/private/hidden.json

notes: One composition (SnF2, three database polymorphs) instead of the design's two compositions. No IR reflectance endpoint. The design's degenerate-partner and intensity-prefactor forks are not graded decision points here: the hidden beta phase has no degenerate modes, and a fit without the (n+1)/omega factors is visibly poor (chi2/point 84 against 2.6) but still recovers the graded values (c axis 1.1 deg, s +0.02 %). Both remain rubric items. The design's quality-flag fork is a rubric item as well: the flags do not decide the phase.
